What is the average of total across all invoice rows? Return one average value.
Group invoice rows by billing_country and give billing_country plus the sum of total for each country.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT billing_country,SUM(total) FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country

cases.question: How much total is invoiced where billing_country equals 'Brazil'? Return one sum.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice WHERE billing_country='Brazil'

cases.question: Tổng total của invoice có invoice_date từ 2010-01-01 đến trước 2011-01-01 là bao nhiêu? Chỉ trả về tổng.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM invoice WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-01-01'

cases.question: Return genre.name and the count of track rows for each genre, joining track to genre by genre_id.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT g.name,COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN genre g ON t.genre_id=g.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id,g.name

cases.question: List only the three track names and summed invoice_line.quantity with the highest summed quantity. Join using track_id and break ties by track_id ascending.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT t.name,SUM(l.quantity) FROM track t JOIN invoice_line l ON t.track_id=l.track_id GROUP BY t.track_id,t.name ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC,t.track_id ASC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Count customer records whose company is NULL; return one count.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE company IS NULL

cases.question: Return customer.country and the sum of invoice.total by customer.country. Join invoice.customer_id to customer.customer_id.
cases.oracleSql: SELECT c.country,SUM(i.total) FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON i.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country
